# Control-type reference

<!-- Generated by `repo-guardian controls docs`; do not edit. Run `make controls-docs`. -->

Every control type repo-guardian ships, with the rule kinds a catalogue
definition may declare and each kind's parameters. A remediable kind may
declare `remediate = true`.

## `branch_ruleset`

- Semantics: 1
- Remediates by: API (`apply` = `recommend`, `direct`)

| Rule kind | Remediable | Parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `exists` | yes | — |
| `matches` | yes | — |

## `catalog_info`

- Semantics: 1
- Remediates by: pull request (takes no `apply`)

| Rule kind | Remediable | Parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `exists` | yes | — |
| `kind` | yes | — |
| `field_set` | no | `field` (string, required)<br>`contains` (string) |
| `annotation_set` | no | `annotation` (string, required) |
| `no_placeholders` | no | `fields` (list(string))<br>`placeholders` (list(string)) |

## `codeowners`

- Semantics: 1
- Remediates by: pull request (takes no `apply`)

| Rule kind | Remediable | Parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `exists` | yes | — |
